notes:
I couldn't research this chapter, so I have no notes to give you. My only search tool stopped working before I could read any pages:

- My first attempt to open pages directly (Enduring Word, Bible Hub, Precept Austin, New Advent, NET Bible) failed. The tool only opens addresses that have already come up in a search, and I hadn't run one yet.
- When I then tried to run the searches, the tool said I had no more uses left for this turn.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for each point, and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I read nothing, I haven't written any verse notes.

If you start a new turn, I'll begin with searches and then read the pages they return. I plan to read:

1. **The traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word on Song of Solomon 1; Bible Hub's pages for each verse (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary, Matthew Henry and others); Precept Austin's Song of Solomon page; StudyLight.
2. **Differences between Protestant traditions:** Spurgeon's sermons on these verses (spurgeon.org; he preached often on vv. 2, 4, 7 and 13); Desiring God and GTY; Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu); Ligonier and The Gospel Coalition; Sam Storms; LCMS and 1517 on Luther's reading.
3. **Other views:** the NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, and New Advent (the Catholic Encyclopedia article on the Canticle of Canticles and the Church Fathers on CCEL) for Catholic readings. I'll also check catholic.com and oca.org, and GotQuestions on how to interpret the book (as a love poem, an allegory or a type of Christ and the church).
